[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Stick to a consistent sleep schedule: Go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, including weekends.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Get some morning sunlight: Exposure to natural light helps regulate circadian rhythms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Avoid screens before bed: Limit screen time for at least an hour before bedtime.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Use a wake-up light: A device that simulates a sunrise to help wake up naturally.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Make a plan for the morning: Schedule enjoyable or important activities for the morning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Use positive self-talk: Remind yourself of the benefits of a consistent sleep schedule.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Get accountability: Share goals with a friend or family member for motivation.
